app_store.name: Cueline: Plays What You Pick
app_store.subtitle: No ads. Fair shuffle.
app_store.promotional_text: Your playlist plays exactly what's in it. Nothing added, no ads, no skip limits, and shuffle that plays every song once before any repeats.
app_store.description:
Cueline is a music player that does what you tell it.

Pick an album or a playlist and it plays exactly that, in the order you asked for. It doesn't slip in recommended songs, and there's no autoplay unless you switch it on.

Shuffle is fair: every song plays once before any of them repeats, the song you're on stays put, and you can see exactly what's coming next in the queue.

No ads. No skip limits. Every song on demand, on the free plan.

What you get:
- Albums, artists and playlists you build yourself
- Heart songs to keep them
- A queue you control: add, reorder, remove, and it's still there after you close the app
- An option to hide your listening history from the home screen
- Keyboard shortcuts on desktop

What you won't get: ads, review pop-ups, podcasts or an AI host in your music.

The music on Cueline is published by the artists and labels who own it.
